newsitem.title: UK: IPE software fix to stop off-market gas trades.
newsitem.headline: IPE software fix to stop off-market gas trades.

text.p: London's International Petroleum Exchange (IPE) intends to improve its computer software to trap off-market trades on the natural gas futures contract, said Richard Ward, the IPE's business development director.

On Monday this week two trades on the natural gas futures were broken after a screen user entered a bid of 90 pence a therm for November instead of nine pence. This triggered the acceptance of offers at 12.95 pence and 19.25 pence, both of which were subsequently set aside.
The software fix will be introduced over the next few weeks and will "trap any bids or offers that break the market," said Ward on Friday.
